svg.title: Proposed single sheet: section through body bolt and circle

g.text: PREVIEW ONLY: one 250 x 1.5 mm sheet, black masked rim
6 mm printed collars / 6.4 mm sheet holes / existing six M3 positions
Blue: continuous sheet. Grey: printed load path. Brown: single wood grid.
Reflecting planes Z=25.5 / 36.7 mm. Gap 11.2 mm. Washer stops at Z=38.2.
